# Exact cXML validation fixtures

These are unchanged official cXML DTDs. Their original notices and license references are retained; they are third-party specification fixtures, not plugin-authored source. No external entity modules are required by these two files.

| File | Official source | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| 1.2.008.dtd | [Official cXML 1.2.008 DTD](https://xml.cxml.org/schemas/cXML/1.2.008/cXML.dtd) | c1da190a44885cb01a7afd286a59683b18208c08ebaaf453ad8d6d669c460f57 |
| 1.2.071.dtd | [Official cXML 1.2.071 DTD](https://xml.cxml.org/schemas/cXML/1.2.071/cXML.dtd) | d267ad7b19cbd6608b972821daacab0f4d94a8ec78610b7127dba23222198a64 |

Retrieved and verified on 9 September 2026. ExactCxmlDtd checks these hashes and resolves only the matching official HTTP/HTTPS SYSTEM identifier locally. It leaves the generated document and its declared version unchanged, refuses other external identifiers and disables network resolution. The runtime serializer does not fetch or load DTDs. Passing validation proves XML conformance to that version, not acceptance of the supplier's fields or prices by a purchasing system.
